title: Riptider
description: This mod is actually for my server Riptider, it's work in singleplayer. It's server and client mod! If you want play on this server, send me messange in discord. My discord username is energi22!
body:
This mod for my server Riptider and this mod have a lot of things and weapons.

There are 12 weapons! One weapon ranged and eleven weapons melee!

There are list of weapons!

Trial Striker - Breeze rod with copper handle (on right click, gives you effect levitation)

Shadow dagger - small echo sword (if you crouching and your equipted boots is Echo Stalkers you deal more damage and after attack, attacked entity will have two 2 effects - Blindness and Weakness)

Voidbound Echo-Scream - bow in echo style (this bow uses custom arrows)

Glass dagger - powerful version of shadow dagger (this dagger deals 12 damage, but it has 1 durability)

Void Reaper - really cool weapon, after right clicks near entities will dash to you

Double-Headed Axe - powerful weapon against shields, with chance 10% you will break your opponent's shield, but with chance 90% shield will got cooldown of 140 ticks

Devouver - with chance 50% your opponent's hunger will decrease by 2 (2 icons of hunger), with other chance 50% your hunger will decrease by 2 (2 icons of hunger)

Storm Chaser - it's upgraded version of Trial Striker, when right clicked, gives you effect levitation and after right clicked you and near entities will have effect Slowness

Diamond Spear - just weapon with high range

Shadow Striker - owner's weapon, it's netherite sword but with black spots, when entity attacked with chance 25% it will have 2 effects - Blindness and Slowness, but with other chance 75% entity will have effect - Slowness, when right clicked you got 2 effects - Speed and Strengh

Abyssal Cleaver - owner's weapon, it's just netherite axe with purple spots (end style)

There are list of other things!

Target Potion - when you drink it, you will be Target, if you survive 10 minutes without dying, you will get 3 diamond blocks, but if other player kills you, he will get this 3 diamond blocks

Breeze rod upgrader - craftable thing that's uses to craft Trial Striker

Totem Of Blood - custom totem

Echo Stalkers - boots that's give you effect Speed when you are not crouching, but if you crouching effect will remove, but you have got higher speed than usual and if you crouching and attacking with Shadow dagger, you will do more damage

Void Crystal - item that's gives you ability to dashing forward

Slowness Star - star that's gives all entities in radius effect slowness not including you

Auto-Smelter - enchantment that's applies on pickaxes and smelting all items that will drop without enchantment

Berserk potion - potion that gives you effect Strengh and Hunger but you can't open any GUI

Glass Cannon potion - potion that gives you effect Strengh but you maximum of hearths is 10 (5 icons of hearths)

Phantom swithcer - swap your and your opponent's positions or your opponent will teleport to you

Diamond-Infused Netherite Pickaxe - pickaxe that gives you ability to build where you can't (it has radius of 10 blocks) and with chance 20% you can get diamond from ores (any ores) and when you crouching you will break near blocks (for example your position is X:100 Y:50 Z:200, you will break blocks from X:99 Y:49 Z:199 to X:101 Y:51 Z:201)

Blood crafting table - custom table that's have custom craft (Totem Of Blood)

And it's all that i made! If you found a mistake or bug, you can send me message in discrod. My discord username is energi22! (If you will send me a message with explaining mistake or bug, i will add you in list of helpers!)
